objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object subject to creation, editing, approval, and archival processes within the policy and guidelines management system.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: A document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: A document type documenting company-wide or locally-defined regulations and instructions.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: A document type describing specific procedures, process sequences, and responsible persons within a framework.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: A document type documenting detailed work steps and sub-processes with associated forms and checklists.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document automatically released with the main document and subject to versioning and release workflow.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and can be deleted directly.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A document that proposes amendments to an existing document without affecting version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to check and extend the validity period of a document.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that has no additional validity.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons assigned to receive document notifications or acknowledgement requests.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A group of users assigned specific authorizations and roles for document management.

objs.name: person
objs.description: An individual user assigned roles and authorizations within the document management system.

objs.name: author
objs.description: A person with read and write permissions responsible for creating and editing document content.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: A person with read and write permissions who can edit documents alongside the primary author.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A person who checks document content for technical and formal correctness.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A person responsible for approving and releasing documents for distribution.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A person authorized to translate released content into other languages.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: A person with read-only access to approved documents.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A user group retaining read access to archived documents.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: A user group with permission to create reactivation requests.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: A specific iteration of a document with associated metadata and status in the release workflow.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: A translation of a document into a specific language subject to separate approval workflow.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A confirmation by a recipient that they have received and reviewed a released document.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by workflow participants during document approval process.

objs.name: audit_trail
objs.description: A record documenting all changes, approvals, and actions performed on a document.

objs.name: template
objs.description: A predefined document structure that can be selected when creating new documents.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A separate organizational instance in a multi-client system with independent document visibility.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attachment of a new document object to the system with selection of document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modification of document content using the editing client that triggers conversion to PDF.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Creation or modification of document properties and attributes organized in categories.

evts.name: assign_authorizations
evts.description: Assignment of reader, author, co-author, reviewer, and releaser permissions to users and groups.

evts.name: submit_for_review
evts.description: Initiation of the three-step release workflow by author or co-author.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer examination of document content for technical and formal correctness.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: Reviewer or releaser decision to reject a document during the approval process.

evts.name: approve_document
evts.description: Releaser decision to approve and release a document for distribution.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Application of electronic signature by workflow participant during approval process.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic publication and distribution of released document to authorized readers.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking of attachment for archival when document version is superseded.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Author creation of proposed amendments to an existing document.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Author decision to implement a change proposal, creating a new document version.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System generation of validity check request when document approaches expiration.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirmation by releaser or document participants to extend document validity period.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: User creation of request to invalidate a document with no additional validity.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Formal invalidation of a document and archival of last valid version.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Business admin creation of request to re-validate a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Confirmation to re-validate an invalidated document and create new version.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Assignment of user groups and persons to document distribution for email or acknowledgement.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: Distribution of email notification to assigned users and groups upon document release.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatic workflow request for recipients to confirm receipt and review of document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirmation of receipt and review of released document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Conversion of released document content into another language.

evts.name: approve_translation
evts.description: Reviewer and releaser approval of translated document version.

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: Creation of role-specific evaluation reports and searches on documents in system.

o2o.description: A document contains controlled attachments that are released with the main document.
A document can be supplemented with additional information not subject to release cycle.
A change proposal is clearly associated with a specific document.
A language version is a translation of a released document into another language.
A document maintains multiple versions throughout its lifecycle.
An author has read and write permissions on documents they create or are assigned to.
A co-author shares editing permissions on documents alongside the primary author.
A reviewer is assigned to check specific documents during approval workflow.
A releaser is assigned to approve and release specific documents.
User groups are assigned to distribution lists for document notifications.
Persons are assigned to distribution lists for document notifications.
A document visibility can be specified for multiple clients in a multi-client system.
A validity extension request is linked to the document requiring validity check.
An override request is associated with the document to be invalidated.
A reactivation request is associated with the document to be re-validated.

o2e.description: Create document event creates a new document object in the system.
Edit document content event modifies the content of a document.
Maintain metadata event updates document properties and attributes.
Assign authorizations event sets permissions on a document.
Submit for review event initiates approval workflow for a document.
Review document event examines a document during approval process.
Reject document event declines a document during approval process.
Approve document event approves a document for release.
Sign document event applies electronic signature to a document.
Publish document event makes a document available to authorized readers.
Archive attachment event marks an attachment for archival.
Create change proposal event proposes amendments to a document.
Implement change proposal event incorporates proposed changes into a new document version.
Create validity extension request event generates a system validity check request.
Extend validity event confirms validity period extension for a document.
Create override request event initiates document invalidation process.
Declare override event formalizes document invalidation and archival.
Create reactivation request event initiates document reactivation process.
Reactivate document event re-validates a previously invalidated document.
Maintain distribution list event assigns users and groups for document distribution.
Send email notification event distributes notifications to assigned user groups.
Send email notification event distributes notifications to assigned persons.
Request acknowledgement event sends workflow task to person for document confirmation.
Confirm acknowledgement event records recipient confirmation of document receipt.
Translate document event converts released document content into another language.
Approve translation event approves translated document version for publication.
Generate report event creates evaluation reports on documents in system.
